title: Duke Ernst of Bavaria to Duke Wilhelm V, 'Post Scripta' dot cipher of April-May 1583, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.96-115 (DECODE R9319; catalogue 161)

steps.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
R9319 identified as dot grilles laid over clear cover letters; the cover letters (ff. 115-118) are not among the DECODE images (one shows through under f.102)

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591 (catalogue 161), whose fourteen records are letters in at least six systems: System A′ stays in kaa4591; Łaski's System B is kaa4591b; R9325 is fulda1576; R9367, R9416, R9424 and R9319 are r9367, r9416, r9424 and r9319; R9291 is a key fragment.

GitHub issue #88 (ry-xu) pointed to Leighton, ZBLG 37 (1974) 828-844; the article fetched from the BSB IIIF scan bsb00009436 (images 152-168) and read in full. Kasten schwarz 13478 ff.96-115 = KAA 4591 ff.96-115: same folios, 'Postscripta' on 96R, 'Presentatur 12 May 83 Monaci' on 107V, Leighton's plate of 96R matches the DECODE sheet; his key strips 'Folio 49' = KAA 4591 f.49 (DECODE R9304).

The 21 Sept description (grilles laid over clear cover letters on ff.115-118) checked against Leighton: wrong. The sheets are a self-contained dot cipher on squared paper read with a strip key (three mixed alphabets plus a code list), f.115 being the last cipher leaf (Presentatur 19 May 83). The text is Leighton's printed decipherment, which he checked against the chancery decipherments; not re-derived from the dots here.

outcome.method_basis: Leighton (1974) deciphered all of ff.96R-115V with the key strips of f.49 and printed the full German text, checked against chancery decipherments of ff.96R-101R and 104R-107R; no reading was derived here.
outcome.notes: Already deciphered by A. C. Leighton 1974 (found 22 Oct 2026 via issue #88, ry-xu). Ernst of Bavaria at Cologne to his brother Wilhelm V on the Cologne archiepiscopal election of May 1583. The 'cover-letter grille' description of 15 Oct was wrong and is withdrawn.

gaps.item: a dot-by-dot transcription aligned with Leighton's text
gaps.detail: f.115 is not imaged on DECODE and the printed text is in copyright; Leighton's reading stands

outcome.texts_withheld: The reading is Leighton's printed decipherment (ZBLG 37, 1974, pp. 836-838, in copyright), cited per entry with short quotations and not copied; it is free to read on the BSB scan bsb00009436 (images 160-162). No dot transcription was made here to align it with.

texts.label: ff.96R-101R, Postscripta, Cologne 22 April 1583
texts.summary: Ernst to Wilhelm V: the imperial commissioners' truce talks with the cathedral chapter, Archduke Ferdinand and the legate, Salentin of Isenburg ('ain aufrech bayrisch herz'), Württemberg, the Baden marriage and the Bishop of Metz's canonries; dated Cologne 22 April [15]83.
texts.note: Leighton 1974 p. 836 (BSB image 160); also the chancery decipherment Kasten schwarz 3634 ff.285-287a.

reading_review.note: Leighton's printed German reads as continuous sentences with a few ciphering slips left as written; not copied (copyright).

texts.label: ff.101V-102R, Aliud Postscriptum
texts.summary: The chapter's letter to the Catholic estates of the Empire, and a new election day to be set for 15 May.
texts.note: Leighton 1974 pp. 836-837; no chancery copy found by him.

reading_review.note: Leighton's printed text, coherent; not copied (copyright).

texts.label: f.103V, trial
texts.summary: A faulty first attempt at the opening of f.96R (Leighton: E/F and K/R confused, Kaiser spelled out).

texts.label: ff.104R-107R, presented at Munich 12 May 1583
texts.summary: The bishop of Vercelli's arrival, a Calvinist tumult in the city, Ernst's ride to Düsseldorf and the Jülich-Cleves marriage talks, Count Adolf of Neuenahr, and the convocation sent to Philipp Truchsess.
texts.note: Leighton 1974 p. 837; chancery decipherment Kasten schwarz 3636 f.42.

reading_review.note: Leighton's printed text, coherent; not copied (copyright).

texts.label: ff.108R-115V, Postscripta, presented at Munich 19 May 1583
texts.summary: French practices, the papal deprivation and the election day, the chapter's troops and money (ten thousand crowns from the Pope, hope of Spanish help), Parma as possible commander, and Duke Ferdinand.
texts.note: Leighton 1974 pp. 837-838; no chancery copy; f.115 is not imaged on DECODE.

reading_review.note: Leighton's printed text, coherent with a few uncorrected slips (DFFEN, KAINULEIL); not copied (copyright).
